note: Validated / builtin-type OpenAPI fixes. A Validated<...> argument after a Path<T> argument now documents the 422 response (the extractor scan stopped at the first Path). ValidatedWith<C, T> is recognised: its wrapped Json / Query / Form / Path body or parameters and the 422 response are documented (previously all missing). IpAddr, SocketAddr(V4/V6) and PathBuf map to string, Ipv4Addr / Ipv6Addr to string with format ipv4 / ipv6 and url::Url to string with format uri, and need no Schema impl (previously the per-field Schema assertion failed and the orphan rule prevented a fix); a user Schema type with the same name keeps its $ref. #[route] asserts that every Validated / ValidatedWith payload implements garde::Validate through the new hidden vespera::__validation::AssertValidate trait, so a rule-less Schema struct or an enum is reported with a dedicated diagnostic at the argument instead of an opaque Handler trait-bound error.
